body.text: The schools are {perception:schools} and the people are {perception:people}, and I am aware I have written something very like that before.
I am carrying {param:amount} a month of what you and I agreed, out of my own pocket, and I should like the Crown to take it back up. I am not asking to enlarge it. I am asking to stop paying for it.

You may reasonably observe that I always say the colony wants more of everything. I do. I would ask you to notice that I have never once said it was enough, at any figure, and to draw whatever conclusion you like about how much my opinion is worth on that particular point.
You may reasonably observe that I always say the same thing. I do. I have not yet been given cause to say anything else.
If the answer is no, say so plainly. I shall carry it as long as I can and then I shall stop, and I would rather you knew that was coming than discovered it.

tone.text: Dr Meakin — on the charge you are carrying I am {choice}.

options.text: sorry it has fallen on you

options.label: the Crown will pay it
options.text: The Crown will take it up in full. You should not be paying for the Crown's schools.

options.label: the Crown will pay half
options.text: Half, and I will not pretend that is generous.

options.label: pay it, and something for him
options.text: In full, and something over for your trouble. You have carried it longer than you should have been asked to.

options.label: he carries on
options.text: You will carry it a while longer. I have other calls on the purse.

closing.text: I am, sir, your obedient servant,
